schedule.decisionTargetRule: For each slot, shift the pinned CP6A-9 Jan 2 decision target for that UTC hour by the exact calendar-day offset. All timestamp groups are processed; decisions use only the currently revealed quote basis.
schedule.staleOrUnavailableBasis: Skip the order submission when the revealed quote basis is absent or older than 60 seconds. Do not substitute another time, quote, candle, or intrabar path.
schedule.firstDayOpening: If a current revealed quote exists, the existing opening action submits four near plans and two far control orders; the remaining three slots submit at most one rotated plan each. If no opening quote exists (as at the beginning of Jan 1 in the pinned source), no quote or order is fabricated; the slot is skipped.
schedule.subsequentDays: At most one rotated plan per UTC slot.
schedule.retention: Keep all accepted order identities, receipts, events, and checkpoints. No pruning or history reset.

gates.financial: Independent reconciliation of every fill, event, command/receipt chain, ending balance and realized gross P&L.
gates.source: Independent traversal of all timestamp groups in the requested interval; source gaps remain explicit and no quotes are synthesized.
gates.recovery: Process restart and cold resume in the same Session, exact idempotent retry, durable cursor and complete order history.
gates.integrity: Shared-source pin mismatch, missing advance commitment, broken hash chain, and persisted database integrity checks must refuse or pass exactly as their assertions require.
gates.resources: One CPU equivalent, 1 GiB RAM, 30 GiB free disk reserve at every replay checkpoint; annual hard budgets are 72 hours and 8 GiB artifacts.

limitations: Schedule acceptance and all week/month/year results remain unproven until the corresponding gates complete.
This is an isolated QA order schedule and does not grant financial execution eligibility or establish broker fills.
Source rights and underlying feed authority remain UNKNOWN.
